# Anthem Air Conditioning & Plumbing

> > Full-service HVAC and plumbing contractor serving Coachella Valley with installation, repair, and maintenance for residential and commercial properties.

Anthem Air Conditioning & Plumbing (CSLB #1001659) has over 20 years of experience serving Palm Springs, Coachella, Yucca Valley, and surrounding desert communities. The company specializes in Carrier and Mitsubishi Electric systems, offering same-day service and energy-efficient solutions tailored to extreme desert climates.
